about: Measured tokens per review dispatch, by reviewer role, effort and model. gstack-evals tokens export turns these rows into the --tokens file gstack's scripts/review-dispatch-compare.ts reads. Plan v3.2, review replay lane, requirement 3. Refresh rows from metered pilots and counted replays; never fill a row by hand.
output_tokens: Output tokens count output plus reasoning tokens per call. Anthropic's usage.output_tokens already includes thinking tokens, so an Anthropic row records output_tokens as reported. Input tokens are usage.input_tokens.
rounding: Every statistic is whole tokens. The median of an even count is the mean of the two middle values, rounded half up. p90 is by nearest rank: the ceil(0.9 * n)-th smallest value.

efforts.full: gstack's full review effort. provider_effort records what the measuring run sent; GSTA-131 ran full as Anthropic output_config.effort high.
efforts.light: gstack's light review effort. GSTA-131 ran light as Anthropic output_config.effort medium.

flag_rules.rule: A row is flagged when n is under min_n or as_of is more than max_age_days before today. Flagged rows still export; the export lists them on stderr.

sources.gsta131-eval1: GSTA-131's eval 1 (org drive handoffs/gsta131-review-replay/eval1): direct Messages API replays on claude-opus-5-5. The specialist rows use only t-testing-code and t-maint-code, 3 trials per effort, the items its bar B3 preregistered for token measurement. The panel's other items ran at one effort only, so they are not pooled into these rows. as_of is the date of its priced pilot calls (2026-10-27), which ran just before the eval.
